Hi HN — I’m Nicole, cofounder of Gambit Robotics (with Eliot Horowitz, cofounder/CTO of MongoDB).

We’re hiring a Founding Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join us in our NYC office.

Gambit is building an AI kitchen assistant that mounts under a range hood and uses computer vision and thermal sensing to understand what’s happening in a pan and guide cooking in real time.

We’re looking for an experienced engineer who enjoys owning systems end-to-end and working across backend, product, and infrastructure in a small team. You’ll be working directly with the founders building software that interacts with sensors, hardware, and AI models in real kitchens.

More info: https://www.gambitrobotics.ai/careers

Email: nicole@gambitrobotics.com
